help.html:
Qorashahar — classic Mafia
How to play/mafia → “I'm in” → the host starts. Night: your role arrives in private chat, you pick a target. Day: talk → trial → confirmation. A night role that sits idle for 2 nights is out of the game. Commands: /extend /next /stop /roles /profile /shop /buy /top /settings
Who winsThe town — when no enemies are left. The Mafia — when its numbers draw level. Maniac, Enchanter, Swindler — as the last one standing. Informer — same target as the Detective. Arsonist — 3 lives. Suicide — hanged at the trial.
Make the bot a group admin: restrict, pin, delete. @qorashahar_mafia_bot

role.citizen.card: Sleeps at night, thinks by day. The only weapons: the trial and common sense.
role.citizen.dm: You have nothing to do at night. By day, listen, compare, vote — that's your weapon.
role.mafia.card: Picks a target at night with the partners. By day, has to look innocent.
role.mafia.dm: At night you pick a target with your partners. By day, the most honest person in town is you.
role.don.card: Head of the Mafia. Whoever the Don points at won't see the dawn.
role.don.dm: At night you pick the target. If your partners can't agree, your word is law.
role.detective.card: The town's only gun. Investigates on the first night; after that, every night: investigate or shoot.
role.detective.dm: One person every night. At first you only investigate; after that the bullet is yours too. How you tell the town what you know is your problem.
role.sergeant.card: A plain civilian, for now. If the Detective dies — the new Detective.
role.sergeant.dm: You're in reserve. The day the Detective dies, you take over the job.
role.doctor.card: Pulls one person back from death every night. Themselves — once in the whole game.
role.doctor.dm: Pick one person every night — they won't die tonight. You can save yourself only once.
role.maniac.card: Mafia and town alike are the enemy. Outlive everyone and the Maniac wins.
role.maniac.dm: The town and the Mafia are both your enemies. Hunt at night, be a nobody by day.
role.hooker.card: Keeps one person busy for the night: they can't do their night job, and can't vote the next day.
role.hooker.dm: Pick one person at night — they make no move tonight and cast no vote tomorrow.
role.lawyer.card: Every night, gets one partner clear of the Detective's check.
role.lawyer.dm: Pick one person at night — if the Detective checks them, the answer comes back “clean”.
role.suicide.card: The goal is the gallows. If the town hangs the Suicide, the Suicide wins the game.
role.suicide.dm: Everyone else is trying to stay alive. You're trying to hang. If the trial picks you, the win is yours.
role.hobo.card: A homeless sage. Sleeps on someone's doorstep at night and sees who comes by.
role.hobo.dm: Whose doorstep will you sleep on tonight? Whoever comes there, you'll see. Your own place stays empty.
role.lucky.card: Walks away from the first attempt on their life. On the second, the luck runs out.
role.lucky.dm: You have one spare life. Think about what you'll spend it on.
role.kamikaze.card: Doesn't go alone. Killed at night — takes the killer along; hanged at the trial — takes one of those who voted for it.
role.kamikaze.dm: You don't go alone. If they kill you at night, your killer goes with you; if they hang you at the trial, one of those who voted for you does.
role.mayor.card: Head of the city. At the trial, the Mayor's one vote counts as two.
role.mayor.dm: At the trial your vote counts as two. Think hard about who gets it.
role.journalist.card: The Mafia's eyes. Stakes out one door at night: who came, and who lives there.
role.journalist.dm: Pick one door at night. You'll learn who came by and whether the one who lives there is a helper or not.
role.killer.card: The Mafia's hired gun. No protection stops the Executioner — except the Detective.
role.killer.dm: Your bullet goes through any protection. Just don't aim at the Detective — you'll be the one who dies.
role.werewolf.card: Starts on the town's side. If the Mafia attacks, the Traitor doesn't die — just crosses over to their ranks.
role.werewolf.dm: For now you're on the town's side. If the Mafia attacks you, you don't die — you cross over to their ranks.
role.arsonist.card: Douses one house with petrol every night. The night the Arsonist picks themselves, it all burns. Three lives burned and the Arsonist wins.
role.arsonist.dm: Douse one house with petrol every night. To light it up, pick yourself — everyone marked burns. Three lives and you win.
role.mage.card: Whoever raises a hand against the Enchanter at night dies instead. Wins as the last one alive.
role.mage.dm: A bullet at night doesn't touch you — it goes back to its owner. Watch out for the trial, and be the last one left.
role.crook.card: Votes at the trial under a stolen name, not their own. Wins as the last one left.
role.crook.dm: Whose vote are we taking? Pick: tomorrow they vote for whoever you want.
role.snitch.card: Plays alone. If the Informer guesses who the Detective is investigating, the game ends — in the Informer's favor.
role.snitch.dm: Pick one person every night. If the Detective investigates that very person on the same night, you've won.
mafia.group_only: You can't play alone — type /mafia in a group.
mafia.busy: The table's taken: a game is on ({phase}). Wait for it to end.
